name: 뿌리요정
appearance: Small hostile wooden root spirit, tangled root feet, bark-mask face and a crown of two red leaves; no humanoid NPC clothing.

motions.stand: Facing left, two crown leaves sway independently and the carved eyes blink, small root fingers uncurl and feet flex while the wooden torso breathes slightly, return to ready stance.
motions.move: Facing left, tangled root feet alternately lift and grip in a distinct walking loop in place, little root arms counter-swing and crown leaves bounce. Keep bark mask and two red leaves consistent.
motions.attack1: Support casting toward left, draw root hands inward around the chest, raise both branch hands in a focused ritual gesture and spread the fingers, crown leaves flare outward, hold the cast then lower hands into original stance. No projectile or screen effect.
motions.hit1: Facing left, bark face winces and root hands cover the chest, torso bends back and feet brace, recover to standing with leaves settling.
motions.die1: Facing left, root feet loosen and buckle, branch arms fall and wooden body crumples onto the ground with crown leaves drooping. Finish recognizable motionless root spirit without breaking into new objects.
